_doc: Bar do Coqueiro (gameplay plan M8, MareBar.cpp): ingredients bought by the bottle/box and mixed at the counter. A drink is the exact SET of its ingredients (order does not matter). Recipes with known=true are on the menu from the start; the others are discovered by mixing them (fame). Customers order known drinks, a 'surpresa' (any recipe, new ones count as discoveries) or ask for an unknown one with a hint. mesh = kiosk product shown in the guest's hand. Places in world cm: station = player's E target inside the U counter, barman = where the bartender stands, stools = [x, y, yaw facing the counter]. seat = [stool seat top cm, how far the root sits ahead of the stool toward the counter].

_doc_prep: Physical prep (CHECKLIST_EXPANSOES 1.1, MareBar.cpp/MareBarWorld.cpp): the player picks an ingredient from the prep bench (E), it shows in the hand, E on the work glass drops it in (stock used then). Every ingredient has a layer in the glass (ice, fruit, spirit/liquid) and a colour for the drink. Steps before serving: 'socar' when the glass holds a muddle ingredient, then 'liquidificar' when it holds a creamy one, else 'bater'. Each step is a mini-action scored 0..1; the average moves the price by prep_tip (±10%). 'Jogar fora' loses what was in the glass; the guest reacts. Places in world cm: bench [x,y,z top,yaw]; shelf {id or tool: [x,y,yaw]} on the bench top; glass [x,y,scale] (a big caipirinha glass, 1.5x a highball, so its layers read from the counter).

_doc_guests: Guests and orders (CHECKLIST_EXPANSOES 1.2): each guest has a taste (tastes) shown in the bubble for a 'surpresa'; a surprise earns 1-3 stars from the recipe's taste score for it (stars_price). Happy hour (happy_hour) and full-moon nights (event 'lua' after full_moon_from) multiply arrivals and allow max_orders_rush guests. A guest served the right drink within regular_wait minutes becomes a regular (max_regulars) and comes back with regular_chance asking for 'o de sempre' (the drink served then): right gives regular_fame and a bigger tip.
_doc_book: Recipe book (CHECKLIST_EXPANSOES 1.3, phone tab 'Drinks'): known recipes with ingredients, price and prep steps; unknown ones as '???' with the hint. A secret recipe cannot be mixed until a VIP guest (vip: fame level vip_fame, chance vip_chance per arrival, name vip_name) is served right and tells it. Knowing every recipe is the achievement 'mestre_drinks' (achievement_fame).
_doc_upgrades: Upgrades (CHECKLIST_EXPANSOES 1.4), 5 levels each, bought at the bar counter (prices per level). liquidificador: wider blender zone (blend_zone per level) and blend_tip on blended drinks; freezer: ice_stock more ice on restock and melt_cut less melting per level (ice melts melt_per_hour, x melt_hot on a 'calor' day); banquetas: seats more guests (capped by the stools) and patience; neon: night_bonus more arrivals from night_from; chopeira: unlocks the 'chope' tap (pour only, no prep) and chope_price per level. upgrade_props: [x, y, z, yaw] world cm of the model shown from level 1. Bartender: knows the starting menu and learns one of the player's recipes every barman_learn_days; barman_error by staff level (1..5) is the chance of botching a drink (guest leaves, ingredients lost). Models face Blender -Y, which arrives as UE +Y: yaw 90 turns that front toward -X, 180 toward -Y.
